purpose: Full stem and group manifest for the fixed 1,600/400/200 split used by the CS-ECF evaluators and the YOLOv11-RGBT reference.
group_definition: first three characters of the image stem
split_construction: Frames were first assigned to consecutive 100-frame groups. The training, validation, and held-out test collections were then constructed from disjoint groups. This artifact records the resulting paths and verifies stem and group overlap.
